chunks: And through his chain, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Abi Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him say: Whoever wants to know that he is from the people of Paradise, let him present our love to his heart; if it accepts it, then he is a believer. And whoever loves us, let him desire the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Whoever is a visitor to al-Husayn (peace be upon him), we recognize him by his love for us, the Ahl al-Bayt, and he will be from the people of Paradise. And whoever is not a visitor to al-Husayn, his faith is incomplete.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.حُبَّنَا: Our love (referring to the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of true faith and entry into Paradise according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) establishing Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) not merely as a ritual, but as a tangible diagnostic of sincere love (mawaddah) for the Ahl al-Bayt. This hadith underscores the Shia theological view that devotion to the Imam of the Time of Ashura is intrinsically linked to the perfection of one's faith (iman) and assurance of Paradise, transforming historical grief into active spiritual verification.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from his father, from Sayf ibn ‘Amīrah, from Abī Bakr Al-Ḥaďrami, who said:

I heard Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) say: Those who want to know if they will be among the inhabitants of Paradise should present our love to their hearts. If their hearts accept loving us, then they are believers. And those who love us, should surely desire (going to) the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Those who repeatedly go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) are recognized by us as the lovers of us, the Ahlul Bayt (a.s.), and they will be among the inhabitants of Paradise, whereas the faith of those who do not go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) is incomplete.
